sources.title: DECRETO por el que se reforman, adicionan y derogan diversas disposiciones de la Ley General de Salud (DOF 15-01-2026; reform no. 141) [Decree amending, adding to and repealing provisions of the General Health Law]
sources.publisher: Diario Oficial de la Federación; reproduced by the Cámara de Diputados (LeyesBiblio, reform history)
sources.version: As published in the DOF of 15 January 2026 (decree dated 10 December 2025). In force the day after publication (Transitorio Primero). Its Transitorio Segundo defers by 180 calendar days the inclusion in art. 245 of catina, dihidroergocristina, nicergolina, norpseudoefedrina, pseudoefedrina, anfebutamona (bupropión), tramadol, GHB, benzquinamida and GBL (by count, 14 July 2026). Reforms art. 234 whole and art. 245 fracción I second paragraph, II and IV; derogates fracción III paragraph 45 and adds its paragraph 56 and last paragraph. Latest reform of the LGS.
sources.how: WebFetch, every chunk read twice and compared by script: art. 234 whole, art. 245 as printed, the Artículo Único on arts. 234 and 245, Transitorios Primero and Segundo

The Cámara de Diputados LGS PDF (current to DOF 15-01-2026) stops at 91,273 characters in WebFetch's copy; so do the mobile PDF, Orden Jurídico Nacional's HTML (current to DOF 07-06-2024) and a gob.mx copy (current to DOF 26-03-2024). Art. 234 was therefore read whole in the Decreto DOF 15-01-2026, which reprints it in full. Art. 245 was assembled from the acts that last reformed each part: fracción I table (DOF 19-06-2017, plus APAAN by Acuerdo CSG DOF 24-12-2018); fracción I second paragraph and fracciones II and IV (DOF 15-01-2026); fracción III (DOF 07-01-2014, with paragraph 45 derogated and two paragraphs added by DOF 15-01-2026); fracción V second paragraph (DOF 19-06-2017). Reform decree no. 110 (DOF 17-11-2017, issuing the Ley General en Materia de Desaparición Forzada de Personas and amending the Código Penal Federal and the LGS) could not be checked, because WebFetch's copy stops before its amending articles. Its subject makes a change to art. 245 unlikely; every other decree from 2017 to 2026 was checked. The editor may want to check arts. 234 and 245 on the consolidated PDF (https://www.diputados.gob.mx/LeyesBiblio/pdf/LGS.pdf).
